scenes.title: 2010 Baystate Hospital Station: Empty-Pocket Slap While Silent Phone Sits Across the Desk
scenes.era: 2010, Baystate Medical Center Doctors' Station, Springfield, Massachusetts

layout.description: Bright sunlit hospital clinic corridor and oak nurses' desk: in the foreground, a 46-year-old physician in a crisp white lab coat and navy trousers stops mid-stride patting and turning out a completely empty right trouser pocket; three meters behind on the clean oak desk, their black smartphone sits completely dark and motionless beside a ceramic mug.

positions.who: On-call physician (clothed 2.5D matte cream-white vinyl adult with smooth earless noseless hairless oval head and surprised 2D charcoal-black ink eyes in white lab coat over teal shirt and navy slacks)
positions.where: standing at left-center in the sunlit clinic corridor pulling the empty white cotton pocket lining outward
positions.facing: glancing down at the empty pocket then turning head sharply toward the oak desk

positions.who: Colleague nurse practitioner (clothed 2.5D matte cream-white vinyl adult in slate-blue scrubs holding an unmarked clipboard)
positions.where: standing beside the oak desk pointing calmly down at the physician's dark, untouched black smartphone resting on the wood surface
positions.facing: angled toward the physician with an amused recognizing nod

props.name: turned-out empty white cotton trouser pocket lining
props.period_detail: immediately communicates the universal phantom-buzz empty-pocket check from Rothberg et al. (2010 BMJ)
props.physical_behavior: State-A: physician's hand darts down to slap the right hip pocket -> State-B: pulls out empty white pocket fabric with zero device inside

props.name: dark silent black smartphone resting untouched on oak desk across the room
props.period_detail: unmarked matte-black glass slab completely powered dark with zero vibration ripples
props.physical_behavior: State-A & State-B: sits 100% still and unlit beside a white ceramic mug three meters away from the physician's hip

actions.verb_sequence: stops mid-stride and slaps right hand onto trouser pocket -> pulls empty white cotton pocket lining outward -> turns head toward the silent dark phone resting across the room

reactions.reaction: 2D charcoal-black ink eyebrows lift in sheepish recognition seeing the phone sitting three meters away
taps own coat pocket knowingly — one of the 68 percent on the ward

scenes.wardrobe: 46-year-old attending physician in crisp white coat, teal button-down, navy slacks; colleague in clean slate-blue hospital scrubs.
scenes.lighting: Bright high-key clinical hallway daylight streaming through tall windows.
scenes.recognition_hook: Your hand dives into your pocket for a buzz you 100 percent felt — and pulls out empty air while your phone sits dark across the room!

key_visual.description: a hospital physician in a white coat pulling out an empty trouser pocket lining in surprise while a colleague points to the dark silent smartphone sitting untouched on a desk behind him

scenes.title: 2017 Yale Conditioning Booth: Overweighted Priors Pressing the False-Alarm Button
scenes.era: 2017, Yale University Perceptual Conditioning & fMRI Suite (Powers, Mathys & Corlett)

layout.description: Clean minimalist testing booth where an adult volunteer wearing a white scalp cap presses a 'felt it' response button even though the tactile pad beside their hand sits disconnected and still.

positions.who: Healthy adult volunteer (2.5D matte cream-white vinyl figure in charcoal knit sweater)
positions.where: seated at a clean testing table with left hand near an idle tactile pad and right hand pressing a response key
positions.facing: three-quarter angle toward unmarked conditioning light cue

props.name: idle tactile conditioning pad and response key
props.period_detail: represents Powers, Mathys & Corlett (2017 Science) conditioned hallucination paradigm with zero text
props.physical_behavior: State-A: soft amber cue lamp blinks while tactile pad stays completely motionless -> State-B: volunteer confidently presses the 'detected' button

actions.verb_sequence: watches the soft cue lamp blink while the pad stays motionless -> presses the response button convinced a pulse occurred

reactions.reaction: confident nod demonstrating how strong priors override silent input

scenes.wardrobe: Charcoal crew-neck sweater and tailored slacks.
scenes.recognition_hook: Train expectation hard enough, and a completely healthy human brain invents the sensation all by itself.

scenes.title: Sunlit Courtyard Bench: Moving the Phone Off Skin Into a Shoulder Bag (Outdoor)
scenes.era: Modern sunlit outdoor brick courtyard & park bench

layout.description: Open-world sunlit outdoor courtyard bench beneath green trees where the off-duty physician slides the silent smartphone out of their trouser pocket and zips it cleanly into a tan leather bag on the bench.

positions.who: Off-duty physician in casual olive jacket
positions.where: seated on a sunlit wooden park bench beside a leather messenger bag
positions.facing: angled toward sunlit trees while zipping the bag closed

props.name: tan leather messenger bag on sunlit wooden park bench
props.period_detail: implements Rothberg et al. (2010) pocket-relocation & vibrate-off habit reset
props.physical_behavior: State-A: adult lifts phone away from hip pocket -> State-B: drops it into leather bag on the bench and leans back relaxed

actions.verb_sequence: removes phone from hip pocket -> places it inside the leather bag on the sunlit bench and leans back calmly

reactions.reaction: shoulders drop as continuous tactile vigilance switches off

scenes.wardrobe: Olive cotton field jacket over white shirt and navy chinos.
scenes.recognition_hook: Take the buzzer off that patch of skin for 48 hours, and your body map stops shouting false alarms.

spatial_contrast_spec.landmark_or_object_a: Empty trouser pocket firing false top-down vibration alert while phone rests 10 feet away
spatial_contrast_spec.landmark_or_object_b: Relocating phone into a carry bag across the desk to reset the thigh touch map

spatial_contrast_spec.cut_b_topdown_3d_arrow: 90-degree top-down room showing a 10-foot gap between the silent desk phone and the #FF2525 false-alarm arrow at the pocket
